headline: Choosing an Emergency Plumber for the Holidays in Henderson
articleBody:
When a plumbing emergency hits your Henderson home during the holidays, finding the right help fast is paramount. You need someone reliable, skilled, and available when most businesses are closed. But how do you choose? It's about more than just finding an open plumber; it's about ensuring quality, safety, and transparency during a stressful time.

Questions to Ask Before You Decide
When you're dealing with a holiday plumbing emergency, asking the right questions can save you a lot of headache and expense. First, confirm their service-area coverage to ensure they serve Henderson. Next, inquire about holiday and after-hours pricing—do they charge extra, and what are their diagnostic and dispatch fees? Understanding arrival-time expectations is also key, so you know how long you might be waiting. Don't forget to ask about their licensing, insurance, and warranty terms for the work. Finally, clarify whether they provide written options before beginning repairs, especially if the issue is complex. For example, CG Plumbing Solutions offers transparent written estimates, so you'll know the proposed scope before work begins, even during an urgent holiday call.

Making an informed decision, even under pressure, ensures you get the professional help you need without unexpected surprises. A reputable plumber will be transparent about their services and costs.
